summary: Completed comprehensive frontend-only testing of Scarllet Aurora landing page on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). Verified hero scroll-scrub video, cue overlays, smooth-scroll navigation, all 6 content sections, and final CTA. All 22 checklist items from the review request PASS. No console/page errors observed. No backend to test (pure frontend marketing site).
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is ~625 lines — still manageable but approaching the 700-line threshold. Recommend splitting Hero, sections into /components/ if more features are added.
getCueIndex thresholds in code are 0.15/0.45/0.70/0.92 — matches the spec exactly.
Hero height uses inline style 420vh — works, but on very tall desktops this is a lot of scroll. Could be configurable. Not a bug.
Video preload='auto' is fine for 2MB webm; acceptable for a hero page.
Minor a11y nit: cue-cta button is present in DOM for all cues but hidden via CSS opacity — kept aria-hidden via aria-hidden on parent when inactive. OK.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified results: Hero is 420vh on desktop (4536px at 1080vh), video duration 5.042s, readyState 4, currentTime scrubs correctly with scroll (0.66s @10%, 1.99s @30%, 3.97s @60%, 5.042 @85%+). Active cue transitions correctly through cue-1 → cue-5 as scroll progresses. CTA [hero-cta-btn] is hidden (opacity 0) for cues 1-4 and shown (opacity 1) for cue 5. Clicking hero-cta-btn smooth-scrolls to final-cta (landed at y=8797.59). Nav adds 'nav-scrolled' class after 80px. On mobile (390x844): hero is 844px (100vh), video autoplays (paused=false), muted, loop=true, currentTime advances. No horizontal overflow on either viewport (sw=cw). Background body color rgb(11,10,9)=#0B0A09. All proof stats (169K, 134K, 126K, 54K), how-steps (Build/Generate/Monetize), 5 who items, final CTA href=mailto:hi@scarlletaurora.com present. All data-testids present and correctly wired.
